summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Pragati Path coaching app. 23/23 backend pytest tests passed, all critical mobile UI flows passed (splash redirect, admin login, parent register/login, payment submit, admin approve/reject, ads CRUD, UPI/template editors, notifications with auto-generated credentials).

minor.issue: Response includes 'issued_password' field in plaintext (the random password generated when payment is approved). Admin can see parent passwords. By design this lets admin re-share credentials, but storing/returning plaintext passwords is a security concern. Consider removing from list response or only returning to admin on demand.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated -> use boxShadow; props.pointerEvents deprecated -> use style.pointerEvents; Image style.resizeMode deprecated -> use props.resizeMode. Cosmetic only, no functional impact.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo doctor reports mismatched: @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@3.0.2 expected 2.2.0; expo-clipboard@55.0.13 expected ~8.0.8; expo-image-picker@55.0.19 expected ~17.0.11. Currently working but may cause future incompatibilities.

action_items: (Optional security hardening) Exclude 'issued_password' from GET /api/admin/users response or move to a dedicated admin-only credentials endpoint.
(Optional cleanup) Address Expo deprecation warnings (shadow*/pointerEvents/resizeMode) and align package versions with Expo SDK expectations.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly excludes _id and password_hash from all responses via projection {'_id': 0, 'password_hash': 0}.
JWT auth implemented per playbook with bcrypt $2b$ hashes, role-based 403 on admin routes; seed_admin updates password if .env changes (verified).

Auto-message template substitution uses .replace('{user_id}', code).replace('{password}', pw) - works but if either placeholder appears twice in template both occurrences are replaced. Acceptable for current template.

Approval flow correctly: sets enrollment_status=enrolled, generates new 8-char hex password, hashes and stores it, stores plaintext in issued_password, creates 2 notifications (enrollment with templated text + child enrolled info) - all verified in test_notifications_template_with_user_id_and_password and test_login_with_new_issued_password.
All interactive elements have proper testID attributes; mobile viewport renders correctly at 375x667.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (login admin/parent, register, pay submit, approve, reject modal, ads create, UPI save, template open, inbox notification rendering, enrolled status, login with new issued password)

seed_data_creation: Test parents created via API/UI (prefixed test_parent_/test_reject_/ui_parent_). Backend startup auto-seeds admin, default UPI (pragatipath@upi, fee 5000), default template, sample ad. No manual seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows working. Default admin admin@pragatipath.com / Admin@123 is auto-seeded from .env on backend startup. After admin approves a payment, parent must use the new 8-char hex password generated by backend (visible in /api/admin/users.issued_password and in their inbox enrollment notification) - their original registration password no longer works. Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var (NOT EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Public preview URL: https://pragati-learning-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_pragati_path.py covers all 23 backend assertions including approve/reject flows, notification text validation, role-based access, _id/password_hash exclusion.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. The reported password mismatch on parent re-login was expected behavior (password is re-issued on enrollment approval). Verified by logging in with the issued_password from admin users response.
